# Vendored: AG Charts Community 10.3.3

Unmodified files from the npm package `ag-charts-community@10.3.3` (the AG Charts release paired with
AG Grid 32.3.3; `npm pack ag-charts-community@10.3.3`, tarball sha256
`ebabc14894560e6be0b5959c682786dae5fc7ad7682f1c4e713ffdf93e368ed7`):

- `dist/umd/ag-charts-community.min.js` -> `ag-charts-community.min.js` (global `agCharts`)
- `LICENSE.txt` (MIT) — must stay with the files.

Community edition only (no Enterprise features, no licence key). Loaded lazily by the dashboard's
**Policy** tab, so the other screens load exactly as before. Vendored so the dashboard works with no CDN /
no network at runtime.
